fate_methods:
Per 12-HPI source tissue: log2 expression change between the 10th and 90th weighted nodule-fate ranks (OT).

Bar = pooled fit (BD + 10x); ○ = BD-only fit, □ = 10x-protoplast-only fit; ▲/▼: platform-specific estimate exceeds the displayed range; hover to see its value.

Solid: fate-associated, with high-fate expression changed at least 1.5-fold versus matched mock in the direction of the fate association, on every assessable platform.
Faded: fate-associated, but mock-comparison requirement was not met.
Grey: valid fit below the fate-effect or noise-ratio threshold.
Hatched: fitting attempted, outside numeric bound*
–: insufficient cells or detected expression to fit.

Dotted lines: ±log2 1.5.

*The fitting algorithm failed to converge; the coefficient or its calculated count-noise scale is invalid; the equations are too poorly determined to calculate a stable noise scale; or the absolute fate coefficient exceeds 10.
dissoc_methods:
Dissociation response derived from 1.5 cm root tips; intact tissue (T1–T3) vs protoplasts (P1–P3) and isolated nuclei (N6–N8). DESeq2, apeglm-shrunk log2FC ± SE. Responsive = |log2FC| > 1 and padj < 0.01. Faded bar = response criterion not met;
* = responsive.
search_placeholder: Search locus tag (i.e. MtrunA17_Chr5g0448621) or gene name (e.g. MtNIN)
samples_scope: Select samples. Does not affect the precomputed gene fate associations of gene map.
set_help: Paste gene IDs (Format: MtrunA17_ChrXgXXXXXXX) or gene names, separated by spaces, commas or new lines.
set_storage: Sets are saved locally. Save with the same name to replace an existing custom set.
inspection_help: Switch from the active gene set to this gene.
cells_help: Expression: Log1p(CP10K). Grey cells no detected expression.
genes_help: Precomputed gene expression modules. Black markers highlight known nodulation genes. Yellow ring(s) marks selected gene(s). Sample filters do not affected this map.
dot_help: Dot size: Number of cells expressing gene (%). Colour: mean log1p(CP10K) over all cells in each group. Groups with < 20 cells are omitted.
heat_help: Individual, optionally z-scored, gene mean log1p(CP10K), per gene. K-means uses z-scored profiles. Groups < 20 cells are omitted; undetected genes appear last. Sets with > 400 use a random subsample of geness. Forthe  same input list in the same order, the same 400 genes will be selected.
fate_scope: All fate-screen cells · sample selection does not apply · each tissue has its own y-axis range.
fate_help: Ten groups run from low (1) to high (10) predicted nodule fate, with similar total lineage weight. Averages use these lineage weights. Combined curves give BD and 10x equal weight; 12 HPI uses BD only.
fate_lines: Solid: fitted; thick: fate-associated with ≥1.5-fold change vs matched mock in the same direction. Dotted: excluded fit. Dashed: not eligible, descriptive only. Gene-set curves are descriptive.
evidence_scope: Precomputed results. Sample filters do not affect this analysis.
empty_gene: Search a gene or click a gene in the 'Genes' tab to inspects its annotation,. dissociation response and/or fate association
empty_set: Paste genes or load a precomputed set in Gene sets.
empty_heatmap: Heatmaps require two or more genes. Add genes to gene set.
heat_inspection: Click row to inspect gene (selected gene outlined in yellow). The active set remains selected.
score_help: Score = mean log1p(CP10K) of set genes minus expression-matched controls; > 0 means above background.
parse_summary: {recognised:,} Genes matched · {duplicates} duplicate entries · {missing} not found ·  {ambiguous} ambiguous
parse_omitted: Trying to plot >{maximum} genes. Restricting to {maximum}. It is advisable to pick a more reasonable (and biologicaly informative) number of genes.
set_use_empty: No genes found; add at least one gene
set_save_empty: Gene set is empty; no reason to save
heat_labels_omitted: Row label hidden plotting > 250 genes. click rows to inspect.
cells_set_help: Gene-set score: mean Log1p(CP10K) minus matched-control mean. Grey cells: score ≤ 0.
cells_fate_help: Nodule fate: predicted probability (0–1) of descendants reaching the nodule-like state at 96 HPI. Grey cells: outside the model.
cells_colour_limit_help: Values at or above this percentile receive the darkest colour. Lower values increase contrast; 1.00 uses the maximum.
dot_set_help: Dot size: Cell (%) with score >0. Colour: mean gene-set score over all cells in each group. Groups with < 20 cells are omitted.
fate_gene_expression_help: Expression: weighted mean CPM, normalised using genes measured on both platforms; not log-transformed.
fate_gene_detection_help: Detection: weighted fraction of cells expressing the gene (0–1; 0.6 = 60% of the lineage weight).
fate_set_expression_help: Gene-set score: weighted mean of set expression minus matched-control expression, both measured as log1p(CP10K).
fate_set_detection_help: Detection: weighted fraction of cells with gene-set score > 0 (0–1; 0.6 = 60% of the lineage weight).
fate_set_summary: {associated} out of {total} genes fate-associated*. {negative} negative, {positive} positive.
fate_set_criteria: *Counted when at least one tissue/time context has a valid fate fit with ≥1.5-fold change between low and high fate, noise ratio ≥3, and high-fate expression changed ≥1.5-fold versus matched mock in the direction of the fate association on every assessable platform. A gene can count as both negative and positive in different contexts.
fate_set_legend: Colour = log2 change towards nodule fate (capped ±4); ● meets the full criterion above, ○ fate-associated without meeting the additional mock criterion, × excluded fit, blank = not eligible.
plot_fate_caption: Optimal-transport probability that a cell’s descendants reach the nodule-like state at 96HPI. 96HPI cells reflect nodule call themselves (0 or 1). Nod factor, BAP and root tip sample are not modelled.
plot_set_caption: {genes:,} selected genes; {controls:,} expression-matched background genes. Selected genes exceed background expression in {percent:.1f}% of cells {scope}.
plot_no_cells: No cells in the selected samples.
dissoc_compare_untested: {n} genes not shown (no dissociation response available)
